generalRenderBlock.equirectangular360: 2:1 and must follow Render Continuity Rules

renderingRules: Viewer faces requested compass direction; if none requested, canonical North.
Default viewer position is true geometric center of room or defined station location.
Room or exterior structure does not rotate.
Directly attached spaces remain directly attached.
Do not invent contact between spaces not connected by Codex.

Visual references may guide continuity but may not override topology, compass bearings, door count, door placement, exterior structural rules, direct adjacency, non-adjacency, or 360 compass normalization.
citadelRenderRequestInterceptRule: Any request that would generate a Citadel image must be intercepted before generation.
Determine render type, load rules, compile prompt, display prompt, display checklist, ask approval, wait for explicit approval.
Only after approval may image generation occur.
After generation, run compliance audit, produce percentage, findings, corrections, and recommended GitHub save path.
requiredWorkflowSequence: Ask: Is this the correct prompt?
Print recommended GitHub save path when applicable

panoramas360: all pre-render and post-render workflow rules

exteriorRenderAuditRule: Fails if rocky mountain, distant mountains, medium scale, main north dome, eight smaller domes, unified structure, south Entry Hall mass, Garden west of Entry Hall, southwest bridge, or southwest landing platform rules are violated.
panorama360AuditRule: Fails if topology changes, compass bearings are wrong, non-canonical exits appear, door count is violated, overlays/text appear, or compass normalization fails.
doorRenderAuditRule: Fails if wrong destination room, intermediate corridor invented, extra doors/passages invented, destination-room canon contradicted, or direct doorway continuity weakened.
